content.comment_body: I'm trying to deploy a [product_name] application to AWS. I created my project using [product_name] ([version_no]), set up my AWS account, and registered my device in AWS IoT. The device is successfully communicating with the cloud and its shadow status is updating as expected. Using [product_name] ([version_no]), I deployed the web application to AWS. Setting up the environment was quite a challenge, but after several attempts it's now working. [product_name] provided a QR code and link to the web app, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk reports the environment health as OK. However, when I access the app, I get an HTTP Status 500 – Internal Server Error. My web programming experience is limited so I’m unsure how to proceed or what further information to share. Any advice from the community would be greatly appreciated.

I managed to temporarily fix the issue by uninstalling [product_name] [version_no] and reinstalling [product_name] [version_no]. It seems there's a problem with [product_name] [version_no] in how it creates the website for AWS.

Is [product_name] [version_no] no longer available for download? Earlier, you mentioned difficulty downloading [product_name] [version_no], yet now you've uninstalled one version and reinstalled another. Did you use official sources or how did you get [product_name] [version_no] so quickly?

I’m surprised at the immediate assumption of using an unauthorized copy. After reading your comment in another thread, I checked my own downloads and found where I had previously saved [product_name] [version_no]. My prior post was meant to inform the moderator and community about an issue with the link to [product_name] [version_no] download. It would be beneficial if the incorrect link pinned in the forum could be updated or replaced with a working one. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a major issue deploying a web application created with [product_name] to AWS, encountering an HTTP Status 500 error. The problem appears related to [version_no], with successful deployment possible after reverting to an earlier version. The deployment process was difficult and users struggled with limited feedback and troubleshooting guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and robust deployment process for cloud applications created with [product_name], meaningful error reporting, and dependable compatibility with platforms like AWS.
